column4: A single small video-game marker icon that floats over a building, in the chunky pixel-art style of a 1990s Build-engine game like Blood or Redneck Rampage: an old straw broom with a wooden handle, tilted, sweeping a little grey puff of dust, bold dark outline, a few flat muted colours, readable at a tiny size, centred and filling most of the frame, on a solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) background. No text, no letters, no shadow, no frame.

No text, no letters, no shadow, no frame.
